items.title: 67750_Sippie Wallace oral history interview
items.q: "Lovin' Sam from Alabam," and "Mama's Gone, Good-bye." That's ________ wrote that.

ctx.x: He wanted me to sing that song and he wanted (unintelligible) so many people asked for "Woman, Be Wise," and "Make Me Do What You Want Me To," and "Lovin' Sam from Alabam," and "Mama's Gone, Good-bye." That's ________ wrote that.
You know that song, your song, "You Got to Know How?" I love that one.
